description: Adds a further six input jacks and eight output jacks to a MetaModule Hub patch, standing for the hardware's MetaAIO expander

inputs.text: Marks the cable that feeds one of the expander's eight extra output jacks; in Rack this jack passes no signal

outputs.text: Marks where one of the expander's six extra input jacks arrives in the patch; in Rack this jack passes no signal

notes: It goes anywhere in the rack: the hub finds it by looking through the patch rather than by looking beside itself, so it does not have to be next to the Hub.
The module is inert in Rack: its jacks record which cables belong to which hardware jack and nothing passes through them.
menu: Jack Aliases — gives each of the fourteen jacks a name of your own, which the hardware then shows
